homepageSections.informationGain: Three distinct customer-supplied visual entry points for automation, manufacturing capability and integrated products.
homepageSections.purpose: Establish positioning and route buyers to relevant procurement paths.
homepageSections.factSource: Customer supplied banner assets and verified business scope.
homepageSections.contentType: Three-slide image carousel with HTML copy and CTAs.
homepageSections.desktopStrategy: Per-slide left/right safe zones from banner manifest.
homepageSections.mobile390Strategy: Per-slide focal crop with separate text panel where needed.
homepageSections.componentDecision: Custom carousel; no generic template overlay.

homepageSections.informationGain: Eight verified product families reduce the 48-item catalogue into buyer-oriented entry points.
Representative real products demonstrate the breadth of available equipment without placing all 48 items on the homepage.
homepageSections.factSource: Product coverage manifest and unique customer images.
homepageSections.desktopStrategy: Balanced multi-column cards on continuous light stages.
homepageSections.mobile390Strategy: Single-column cards with full product visibility.
homepageSections.componentDecision: Custom cards; candidate product-motion not adopted before source validation.

homepageSections.informationGain: Shows how equipment, integration, machining and control software combine into project delivery.
homepageSections.factSource: Customer equipment, software and workshop materials.
homepageSections.desktopStrategy: Integrated image-text layout without white inset frames.
homepageSections.mobile390Strategy: Stacked images and concise capability blocks.

homepageSections.informationGain: Explains the engineering sequence from requirement analysis to delivery support.
homepageSections.purpose: Set buyer expectations for a custom automation project.
homepageSections.factSource: Customer service scope and safe generic engineering sequence.
homepageSections.mobile390Strategy: Vertical process track with readable nodes.

homepageSections.informationGain: Real customer images provide evidence of automation lines, forming and heavy machining capability.
homepageSections.componentDecision: Custom media gallery; privacy gate before publication.

homepageSections.informationGain: Maps products and engineering services to assembly, feeding, rugged control and industrial software tasks.
homepageSections.purpose: Allow buyers to start from a problem rather than a model.
homepageSections.componentDecision: Custom solution cards with consistent line icons.

homepageSections.informationGain: Verified 2014 founding, approximately 9000 square metres and three workshops provide concrete company context.
homepageSections.purpose: Replace vague marketing with verified facts.
homepageSections.contentType: Three factual data points and company summary.
homepageSections.mobile390Strategy: Immediate static values without relying on counters.

homepageSections.informationGain: Safe grouped answers reduce repeated questions about planning, selection, integration and technical communication.
homepageSections.factSource: Customer FAQ after removing prohibited service-commitment rows.
homepageSections.componentDecision: Inspect original-grouped-faq after source takeover; accessible fallback required.

homepageSections.informationGain: An honest empty or published state demonstrates maintainable article capability without fabricated news.
homepageSections.factSource: Supabase published articles only after engineering takeover.
homepageSections.contentType: Empty state or equal-height article cards.
homepageSections.desktopStrategy: Three-column equal-height cards when data exists.
homepageSections.mobile390Strategy: Single-column cards with date and title.

homepageSections.informationGain: Structured RFQ fields and visible CAPTCHA help buyers submit a project-specific inquiry.
homepageSections.factSource: Current contact details and inquiry requirements.
homepageSections.contentType: Contact block and scoped CAPTCHA form.
homepageSections.componentDecision: Custom form; server-side atomic CAPTCHA implemented after v0.
